textStr:
Due to its vast territory, the Shenxiao Empire divided its land into 5 Circuits
according to the historical geographic origins, each governed by a military governor.

The founder of the Sect is the younger sister of Shenxiao's founding emperor, Xiang Yun.
The familial ties are the fundamental reason for the Sect's unwavering loyalty to the Empire.

Kitsune women are gifted with beauty and grace. While many
celebrate their distinct features, they are also frequently employed as spies.

To attract talented disciples, the masters from the Seven Mountains establish many Taoist
abbeys throughout the land. They also try to maintain good relations with the secular world.

The Shenxiao Empire is more ancient than the Holy Church. Before the Caelums
established the Church, the Xiang family was already a powerful force in the northwest.

The Chen, Wang, Zhao, and Liu families are the most powerful within the Empire.
The check-and-balance dynamics between them has persisted throughout the empire's history.

The Shenxiao Empire once had an all-out war against the Holy Church, but due to their
inability to secure a victory, one could barely find any records about it in historical texts.

Residents of Longbei Circuit frequently face attacks from northern raiders.
To defend themselves, they have gradually grown to value martial prowess a lot.

Due to the Empire's well-developed agriculture, there are always surplus crops
for brewing, leading to the development of the continent's greatest alcohol industry.

The Shenxiao Empire's formidable power comes not only from the assistance of
the Sect but also its comprehensive conscription and household registration systems.

The Dainichi Mikami revered by the Izumonians shares the same origin as the god
worshipped by the Holy Church, and this explains the good relationship between the two nations.

The succession ceremony of the Mikohime is of great importance for the Izumonians.
It means that a Miko has gained the favor of the Dainichi Mikami and become one with the deity.

Though located within the borders of Izumo, with the current Mikohime promoting
active trade, products from foreign nations can be seen all around the Uezakura region.

Despite the presence of numerous powerful clans within Izumono-kuni, at the
command of the Mikohime, they will all rally and adhere to her directives as one.

The Mikohime of Izumono-kuni possesses the ability to sense changes in
ley lines, allowing them to detect Monster Tides and alert the locals in advance.

Upon assuming the position of Mikohime, one must sever all ties
with the secular world, including family, friends, and even her own past.

The Izumonian ninja are the most skilled intelligence agents on the continent,
carrying out missions with deadly efficiency while remaining steadfastly loyal to their lords.

The Oni are a rare race exclusive to the island of Izumo, known for their violent nature
and inhuman strength, valuing the strong and finding joy in raiding and fighting humans.

Following the ascension of a new Mikohime, a few outstanding Miko
will then be selected at the Izumo Grand Shrine to serve as Miko-in-waiting.

The Izumonian people love cherry blossoms, for they are the symbol of Dainichi Mikami.
On the streets of the Izumo Grand Shrine, cherry trees in full bloom can be seen everywhere.

In fact, there are quite a lot of human beings living in the Mist Forest,
but they appear scarce due to the much greater size of various other races.

In the court of the Mist Kingdom, it is said that no matter how great your mistakes are,
Her Majesty will always remain calm and unfazed. That is, unless you inquire about her age.

Most parts of the Mist Forest are relatively safe, except for the Murky Grove
to the north, where many exiles always lurk, posing significant danger to mortals.

There are only 2 safe passages into the Mist Forest: from the Green Valley
and the Murky Grove. Entry from other areas is considered a serious offense.

While many outside the forest say that the Mist Elves are a legendary race
subsisting solely on dew and vegetables, in reality, they also consume meat.

At the heart of the Kingdom's capital, Astorias, stands a towering tree—
the first Tree of Life planted by the Elf Queen upon her arrival in the Mist Forest.

The Mist Kingdom deploys substantial troops to defend against monsters
at the Gray Gate, leading to insufficient defense in other parts of the Forest.

Whether firearms or bows are more superior weapons is a taboo topic in the
Mist Forest, as it often sparks collective brawls between the Elves and the Dwarves.

Regardless of race or background, anyone willing to dedicate
themselves to the Mist Forest can become a legal citizen of the Mist Kingdom.

Unlike many nations, the nobles of the Mist Kingdom, although they enjoy certain
privileges, have duties not so different from those of the civil servants of the Aaron Republic.

The mages and mechanics of the Republic of Aaron were once at each other's throats,
however, with the emergence of Magitek studies, their relationship gradually improved.

The Republic Guild originated from the Merchant Guild of Port Effengate, the first ever
organization to advocate against governmental interference and promote merchants' rights.

The Aaron Republic currently owns over a thousand technological products
unrivaled on the continent, with a third of these patents held by a single prolific inventor.

The Aaron Republic once sought to seize the Surging Islands. However, due to the
large number of pirates residing there, they had no choice but to resort to soft tactics.

The position of High Mage is the highest rank achievable by Republic mages,
and only High Mages are allowed to build their own mage towers within the nation.

Most of the Aaron Republic's territory consists of uncultivable swampland, thus
frequent imports of food from other nations to meet domestic demand have become a must.

The Surging Islands are infested with pirates who occasionally harass the southern
coastal regions of the continent and disrupt the Aaron Republic's maritime trade routes.

The Republic Academy of Advanced Magitek, a hub for all the
Republic's geniuses, is famously nicknamed the "Bomb Factory."

"Explosion Avoidance and Practical Tips for Experimental Failures"
is currently the most popular course at the Republic Academy of Magitek.

Many of the current commercial systems are brought about by the Republic Guild. As a nation,
the Aaron Republic contributes a lot to the overall trades and business relations of the continent.

For angels always conceal their identities with magic while traveling,
ordinary people may not recognize them even if they encounter them on the road.

The Holy Church's regulations for common believers are not actually strict.
Their basic teachings are mainly about encouraging people to love and to do good deeds.

Descendants of angels and mortals are not uncommon,
but angelic blood does not always manifest in every hybrid.

The Continental Conference, initiated by the Holy Church, aims to unite various nations
to defend against the Monster Tides. Only those recognized by the Church are invited to it.

To deal with sudden surges of Monster Tides everywhere, most clergy members
of the Holy Church have received combat training and often lead the charge into attacks.

For they've always been under the protection of the Holy Church, most people of the Pearly
Realm are loyal to the Church, and will immediately don their armor when a Monster Tide hits.

Ordinary people only believe that Lady Saint is the leader of the Holy Church.
Only a select few are aware that the true decision-makers are actually the Holy Assembly.

Angels are an all-female race. They do not rely on mating with mortals to reproduce.
Instead, they give birth to new lives through the mutual combination of their own powers.

Every year, the Holy Church takes in a large amount of orphans due to Monster Tides
and wars. Caring and giving, they have never abandoned anyone who seeks help from them.

The Holy Church used to establish an Extermination Order, requiring all
participating nations to provide troops and supplies to fend off the Monster Tides.

Eutopia has integrated many powerful individuals who couldn't fit into the world
and were forced to wander to the north. It is said that even dragons exist among them.

In the harsh northern lands, the weak must learn to stand together in order to survive.
This is the only way for them to see through the difficulties in the dire circumstances.

In the north, there is a special crop that can survive under thick snow.
Its tenacious vitality makes it a crucial food source for the northern inhabitants.

The Northern Mounts, also nicknamed "the End of the World,"
boasts the tallest peaks and the coldest ice caves on the continent.

The northern seas are filled with floating ice. Only the most skilled captains and the
most fearless crews can navigate these treacherous waters to conduct business in the north.

Those who have never lived in the northern regions can never
comprehend the immense value of a hearty meal or a piece of clothing there.

The winters in the north are harsh, making it difficult for any life to survive,
but this is also why it always suffers the least damage during Monster Tides.

It is said that when one is at their wit's end, the demons driven to the north by
the Church will appear, tempting them with irresistible offers in exchange for their souls.

There are few native races in the north. Most of the current residents are
either descendants of the exiles or those who have been forced to flee here.

To avoid the biting winds and heavy snow, the residents
of the north often choose to live in caves or underground.

In the Shenxiao Empire, the majority of internal promotion pathways are controlled
by noble families, with only very few ways available for commoners to ascend the hierarchy.

Despite the Sect's idea to cultivate peace of mind and to stay secluded,
the current masters are mostly in support of the Empire's external military campaigns.

While there have been attempts to overthrow the Xiang family's rule, the Sect,
ever so devoted to the imperial family, remains an insurmountable barrier for them.

The powerful and the influential act however they want, while the commoners
can only be at their mercy—such is the current state of the mighty Shenxiao Empire.

The female Kitsunes, without the protection of major powers, are condemned
to a lifetime of going from one man to another, never having a chance to escape.

The Sect wants to exploit the ley lines of the island of Izumo, transforming it into their own
training ground, which has been the main reason for the Empire's several invasions of Izumo.

The Zhao family once ranked among "the Great Four" of Shenxiao, alongside Chen, Liu,
and Wang families, until they were defeated in a power struggle, leading to their downfall.

Whenever the Sect masters spot promising young talents, they persuade parents to
send their kids into the mountains. It's also a way for some to move up the social ladder.

The current Shenxiao Emperor, Xiang Ming, is often looked down upon in private
due to his youth, and is only regarded as a pawn in the power struggle among the officials.

In truth, if the surplus food within the Empire were sent to the grasslands, the nomadic
people wouldn't have to worry about the winter, but the Empire has no reason to do so.

Despite their simple yet brutal nature, due to the Oni's exploitable
combat prowess, the Izumonian people are able to make peace with them.

Almost every Mikohime ends up dying defending against Monster Tides, or to
suffer bodily damage from excessive strain on the ley lines, leading to an early death.

People only view the Izumo ninja as highly skilled intelligence agents,
and are often unaware of the inhuman torture and suffering they have endured.

The strict rules requiring a Mikohime to sever ties with secular society stem from
a past Mikohime who chose to abandon her duties for the sake of her personal affairs.

To counter the Shenxiao Empire's invasion, the former Mikohime ordered isolationism,
choosing to ban all incoming and outgoing ships, permitting only a few to enter the island.

Izumo ninja excel not only in infiltration and assassination, but are also adept at
interrogating prisoners, as their extensive suffering has taught them how to inflict pain.

Because Izumono-kuni is led by the Mikohime, likewise,
local shrines also prioritize women in positions of power over men.

In the traditional education of Izumo warriors, the most honorable act is to
dedicate oneself fully to the nation, the lord, and the greater cause, even their lives.

A Mikohime typically delegates her powers to the local daimyo,
so security conditions vary across different regions of Izumono-kuni.

For Izumo commoners aspiring to high positions, aside from earning military achievement,
entering the Izumo Grand Shrine and assuming a Miko's role is often the only path available.

Outsiders may not know it, but the Head Patrol Officers of the Mist Kingdom actually
have the authority to execute any foreigners who might endanger the Kingdom right on the spot.

Residents of the Mist Forest are highly valuable. The sales of a single
Fairy or Elf are often enough to sustain an ordinary civilian for several years.

Betraying a companion is a grave crime in the Mist Forest,
punishable by terrifying penalties that would make one wish for death.

Many Elves from the Thorn Troopers have suffered abuse at the hands of humans,
which is why they harbor hatred toward humans, and are mostly unwilling to help humans.

The mountain paths of the Mist Mountains are heavily patrolled, and these patrols
are like grim reapers to slave hunters, as being caught by them means certain death.

Hostile tribes have appeared in the Mist Forest before, but those
unwilling to integrate with the forest community are eventually expelled.

"Fairy in a Bottle" is highly sought after because of the Fairies'
cute and resilient nature, making them a popular local specialty.

Owning an Elven slave is a symbol of status in many nations. Not only does it
signify wealth, but it is also proof of strength that one is able to deal with any Elf retaliation.

The tolerance and indulgence of slave trade by human nations is the main reason
why the Kingdom of Mist has begun implementing extreme exclusionism policies.

Although the Elf Queen always wears a smile, this does not
mean that she will show mercy to her enemies in times of war.

The black market in Port Effengate offers all kinds of illicit goods,
from slaves of rare races to princesses of small nations, everything.

Though the current leader of the Aaron Republic doesn't encourage it,
the slave trade remains a highly remunerative business in the Republic.

Hidden within the coasts of Port Effengate is a secret harbor that serves
as a hub for all kinds of shady business, and the place is thus nicknamed the Slave Bay.

To prevent foreign interference in domestic affairs, the Republic Guild established a rule
prohibiting domestic merchants from accepting foreign funding to disrupt the local market.

The Aaron Republic's Magic Association prohibits using Aaron citizens
for magical experiments. Violators will face severe punishment if caught.

Sometimes, the only difference between the Republic Navy
and pirates is the flag that the captain chooses to fly that day.

Elves from the Mist Forest were the ones who originally introduced magic to Port Effengate,
but the Republic chose to conveniently ignore the fact after the Republic Guild rose to power.

Although necromancy is explicitly banned by the Holy Church for being profane,
some still secretly research this forbidden art in their mage towers within the Republic.

In the Republic, many elite families live glamorous and elegant lives
on the surface but engage in sordid and unscrupulous activities in secret.

Every merchant of the Republic of Aaron knows that the fastest
way to build wealth is through two types of business: arms or slaves.

The Hidden Blades is a secret unit directly under the seniority levels of the Holy Church,  
tasked primarily with extinguishing any opposition that threatens the position of the Church.

While everyone knows of the unwavering loyalty of the holy knights to the Church,
few are actually aware of how swiftly those who go back on their oaths find "redemption."

A small kingdom once betrayed the Holy Church for the demons. They
ended up being branded as heretics and wiped out from the pages of history.

The Holy Church prefers its faithful not to know of this, but for the Holy Assembly,
eradicating traitors is far more crucial than shielding humanity from Monster Tides.

Although there are Caelums who maintain close relationships with mortal races,
within the Assembly, there are also many who regard mortals merely as pets or ants.

Despite splitting from the Holy Church, both the Monastery of Mones
and the Miraleno Cult are formed by members often perceived as zealots.

The selection of the Saint is always overseen by the Holy Assembly, with one
simple requirement: The shepherd must be capable of managing the flock on their behalf.

Over time, few remain aware that it's not because of the Monster Tides but the war
between the Caelums that Desolate Lands and the Wasteland are what they are like now.

In the Pearly Realm lies a building without any doors or windows—
the seat of the Holy Assembly, a sacred place accessible only to angels.

To urge the entire continent to hunt down the traitors, the Holy Assembly would fabricate
legends and rumors, transforming the northern deserters into demons in the eyes of the world.

Since their recruits are mostly fugitives or refugees, Eutopia employs
harsh measures to brainwash those morally corrupt and uncontrollable.

To the exiled commoners in the North, the Holy Church
is like a paper tiger—undeniably present but utterly ineffectual.

In the frigid North, mutual cooperation is the only means of survival,
but sadly, most of those arriving here fail to grasp this fundamental truth.

Upon its establishment, Eutopia laid down its
most vital rule: No mercy should ever be shown to the angels.

Eutopia extends its hands only to the worthy or the obedient. Those who
do not meet these conditions receive no assistance—a harsh yet reasonable policy.

Before every major Monster Tide, Eutopia would dispatch troops to harass
the Church's various outposts, aiming to sow discord between them and the other nations.

Every northern Caelum despises the derogatory term "demon" attributed to them,
though occasionally, to strike fear into their enemies, they'd reluctantly accept such names.

The Caelums who fled to the North once considered negotiating
with the Holy Church, yet their envoys never returned after departing.

In the lawless northern lands, members of Eutopia are the absolute rules—
whether others comply is inconsequential, they are the sole moral standards.

To secure enough food for the winter, many northern residents
will join forces and raid the Mist Forest or the Shenxiao Empire.
容姿端麗、運動神經超群的完美學生會長劉飛雪，她唯一的缺點就是喜歡偷吃學生會會計的便當。
洛綰嫣其實沒加入學生會，她只是喜歡在學生會室喝茶，順便欣賞學生會成員之間吵架的模樣。
神霄附屬高中雖然建校已久，擁有豐富的歷史底蘊，但現任校長其實還在上小學四年級的課程。
「我要代替天子懲罰你！」是神霄學生會在糾正壞學生時的常用口號。
「自由、平等、博愛」雖然打贏枕頭仗贏不到這些東西，但在出雲高中，你可以贏到其他同學的下午茶點心。
沒有蛋糕的話就吃麵包，沒有麵包還可以吃魚，出雲高中的伙食供給種類相當豐富。
為了避免傷亡，出雲高中針對鬼族（特別是鬼小滿）訂定了「打枕頭仗只能使用空氣枕頭」的規則。
以極快的速度在敵方手中放上模型蟑螂，藉此無力化敵人，這是忍術研究部部長橘千代的拿手戰法
戀愛，那是無比苦澀的滋味，就好像來打掃泳池卻沒有帶水槍來玩一樣。
米斯特綜合學園的校規中有一條相當重要的規定，在喝任何飲料時，都需要注意杯子裡面是否有其他學生。
芙蕾在白天是普通的女孩子，一到晚上就會變成女僕怪盜芙蕾，這是鮮少有人知道的秘密。
由於會對在校生的心理健康和信心造成負面影響，賽倫汀娜校長已經被永久禁止穿著比基尼旁觀游泳課。
每當情人節一到，亞倫學園就會上演殘酷的巧克力戰爭，每年因為這場戰爭而需要送洗的衣物高達三百六十七件。
儘管在理科方面的成績比不過米斯特綜合學園，不過！亞倫學園的科學技術依然是世界第一。
北風造就維京勇士，亞倫學園造就全國第一的學生意外傷亡率。
科學家之間會互相吸引，亞倫的贊歌就是科學的贊歌，亞倫的偉大就是科學的偉大。
凱瑟琳是聖教會女子學院有名的同人作家，筆名為薔薇・K・灰咲花的她，創作的作品席捲全校，開啟了大耽美時代。
艾爾菲娜，立於全校數百名腐女頂點的高貴存在，她帶領的漫研社以超高的產能和超精準擊中性癖的作品聞名全國。
這個秘密有很多人知道，如果你對聖教會女子學院的學生潑熱水，她們的衣服會濕掉。
正義也許會遲到，但米迦勒的交稿日期絕對不會。
理想高校是全國運動大會奪冠的熱門強校，他們擁有七名實力超群的體育專科生，在校生也都是擁有鋼鐵意志的不良。
理想高校是所有不良少年心中的聖地，每個禮拜，混混們都會向最強的番長路西法進貢大量布丁。
理想高校的吉祥物是一根超級無敵大的熱狗，據說這是出自番長路西法的巧思。
衝鋒隊長菲莉克絲雖然身材嬌小，但與她對撞過的暴走族都表示，她簡直就和一頭巨龍沒兩樣。
